nom: Perricone MD Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report improved plumpness, hydration, and softer lines, though one notes mild tightness and itching that eases once she applies her moisturizer.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin reports it is neither drying nor greasy and helps minimize fine lines.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report good tolerance with no redness or breakouts, including one managing autoimmune-related sensitivity and dehydration who found the serum calming; visible improvement in lines was modest for one of them.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who describes her skin as normal to dry says it is gentle and produces some smoothing and light exfoliation.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s, 50s, and beyond mostly report visibly softer lines, better texture, and plumper skin with consistent use; one reviewer, however, says she can't tell much difference and wonders if she simply has too many wrinkles for it to address.
segments.oily: The one reviewer with oily skin says it absorbs quickly without feeling greasy and still leaves her skin looking plumper.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visibly softer fine lines and deep creases with continued use, sometimes within one to two weeks; a substantial number, however, say they saw little to no change in their deepest creases even after several weeks of consistent use, though several of these still noticed softer, plumper skin overall.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across skin types, describe the serum as strongly hydrating and plumping, often noticeably softening the look of skin within the first week of use.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness or irritation, including several with sensitive skin, and one notes her complexion looks visibly less red than usual; one reviewer who had no reaction herself still cautions that the formula could be irritating for some with sensitive skin.
concerns.spots: The one reviewer who looked for the dark spot improvement claimed by the brand says she hasn't noticed a change there yet.
concerns.blemishes: No reviewer reports new breakouts, including one who specifically describes her skin as acne-prone and says it wasn't triggered.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer with oily skin reports the serum absorbs quickly without adding any greasiness.

aspects.libelle: Can pill if layered before fully dry
Considered expensive for the results seen

extraits.texte: I usually apply in the morning and night and it soaks right up in my skin no redness or breakout with my sensitive skin. I apply my moisturizer after it has been fully soaked in and have had no issue but also haven't seen a big difference. I included two pictures one with glasses frames with Christmas lights that was around Christmas and the second from today and even though I've been using this regularly I haven't seen any massive changes. At the very least it does help make my skin feel super soft.

extraits.titre: I can't wait to see my final results!!
extraits.texte: I've been a Dr. Perricone fan for as long as I can remember and was so excited to add this product into my routine! I have dry skin and am in my mid MID 40's so I'm trying everything I possibly can to help my skin. I've been using this serum AM-PM and have noticed some results. Are they absolutely noticeable…No, but they are subtle and that works for me! What I'm noticing is a relaxed and plumper look around my laugh lines and the 11's between my eyebrows. My complexion is even looking less red than it normally does. I do feel a little bit of tightness and mild itching but nothing that would make me less likely to use. I just apply my moisturizer and the hydration comes back. My skin feels so soft and I'm not feeling any stickiness. I'm loving the pump and the amount of product you do get. I can definitely see myself purchasing. I would say the only drawback would be the Rose scent or at least that's what I'm smelling. It dissipates quickly though.

This is such a lovely serum! The scent is beautiful — a soft, light rose that feels very luxurious without being overpowering. It absorbs quickly into the skin and doesn't leave behind any residue or tackiness, which I really appreciate. Most importantly, it hasn't caused any breakouts. After a few weeks of consistent use, I do feel like my "11 lines" and some of my forehead lines look a bit softer and smoother. The brand also mentions dark spot improvement; I haven't noticed a change there yet, but I'm hopeful with continued use.

I'll preface this by saying I generally love Perricone products and I do like this one. A little goes a long way and it feels great. It smells very clean and fresh and not too over powering. It's great for my combination skin type. It's not drying but not too greasy. It's settles in nicely and leaves my skin feeling soft and minimizes fine lines. I think as I use it more it will help even more. My only complaint is the bottle dropper. It seems to not work as well as it should. But I can deal with that!! I like the product!

I received this from Influenster in exchange for an honest review and have been using this for about a month now. So far, I have loved this serum. It's been easy to incorporate into my routine. I use it after my Omnilux red light mask and swapped out my Medik8 peptides while I was testing this. While it's probably too soon to tell the difference when it come to creases, it's left my skin feeling radiant, plump, hydrated, moisturized, and evened out skin tone. It looks great under makeup as well and seems to smooth out texture. I've used it under both foundation and tinted moisturizer. I'm 39, have husk dry skin, sensitive skin that is both dehydrated and lacks moisture and I also deal with autoimmune issue. I've had no redness, sensitivities, or any issues using this. If anything, it's somewhat calming. It is scented, but it's a pleasant smell I look forward to using and most of my products are unscented. So it speaks to the quality of the product. My Medik8 peptides I usually use are very sticky and tacky (but effective). This has a silky, smooth, none tacky texture. So if you don't like tacky textures, this is for you. My only con, is the dropper. It seems to be faulty. I have to squeeze several times to pick up product and release product.

I have been using this deep crease serum for a few weeks and my wrinkles are becoming less noticeable. The liquid is smooth on skin and handy dropper to squeeze just the perfect amount of drops to your liking. I used the serum on my forehead, above lip area and in between my brows. My skin responds well to this serum and I notice a difference right away after applying. Skin texture looks more even. Serum dries quickly and fully absorbed. Did not irritate my skin and has no scent to speak of. Love this serum for my mature skin!

I am in awe of the Perricone MD Neuropeptide Deep Crease serum. It makes my skin feel exceptionally soft and look very smooth. It helps to hydrate and smooth out my frown lines and forehead. My skin feels bouncy, youthful, and looks renewed. I like that it is non greasy, as I have oily skin. It absorbs easily and pretty quickly into my skin. It layers well under my moisturizer and makeup.
